about: 관리 > 일용근로 근무현황(E020752) — 2091/09 에 일용근로 근무 전표 둘(9/02 에 1 · 0.5, 9/03 에 1)을 넣어 두면, 기준일자 2091/09 로 검색했을 때 전표일자 차례로 날마다 '2091/09/02 계 1.5' · '2091/09/03 계 1' 과 합계 2.5 가 나온다. 시험 자료는 지운다.

shots.name: 근무현황 — 날마다 소계 · 합계
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const mk=async n=>(await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:n,foreigner:false,employmentInsurance:true,pensionAuto:false,healthAuto:false,dailyWage:150000})})).json());const a=await mk('QA관리-일용S1');const b=await mk('QA관리-일용S2');const s1=await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({slipDate:'2091-09-02',lines:[{workDate:'2091-09-02',workerId:a.id,quantity:1},{workDate:'2091-09-02',workerId:b.id,quantity:0.5}]})})).json();const s2=await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({slipDate:'2091-09-03',lines:[{workDate:'2091-09-03',workerId:a.id,quantity:1}]})})).json();sessionStorage.setItem('qaDs',JSON.stringify({a:a.id,b:b.id,s:[s1.slipDate+'/'+s1.slipNo,s2.slipDate+'/'+s2.slipNo]}));return true})()

expect:(()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')].map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim());const i=t.findIndex(x=>x.startsWith('2091/09/02 계'));const j=t.findIndex(x=>x.startsWith('2091/09/03 계'));return i>0&&j>i&&t[i].endsWith('1.5')&&t[j].endsWith('1')&&t[t.length-1]==='합계 2.5'})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const q=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qaDs'));let ok=true;for(const s of q.s){ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries/'+s,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok}for(const w of [q.a,q.b]){ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers/'+w,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok}sessionStorage.setItem('qaDsClean',String(ok));return true})()
